_meta.purpose: City-specific rainwater harvesting mandates and approval complexity tiers.
source_standards: Tamil Nadu Municipal Laws Ordinance 2003 (RWH mandatory all buildings)
Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage (Amendment) Act 2009 / 2021 amendment
Mumbai DCPR 2034 + Maharashtra state RWH rule (plot >= 300 sqm)
Delhi UBBL 2016 + DJB RWH mandate (plot >= 1000 sqm or roof >= 100 sqm)
honesty_notes: RWH thresholds are well-published and stable — these values are accurate.
Approval complexity tiers are heuristic. Real timelines depend on city
officer responsiveness, document completeness, and plot zone.
Citizens should verify with their architect or directly with the authority.
Approval check is INFO-only (never HARD-fails); it sets expectations.

chennai.regulation: Tamil Nadu Municipal Laws Ordinance 2003 + TNCDBR 2019
chennai.notes: RWH mandatory for ALL buildings (public + private), no exemption. No water/sewer connection issued without RWH compliance.

bangalore.authority: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB)
bangalore.notes: Mandatory for new buildings on plots >= 1200 sqft (~111 sqm). 2021 amendment further tightened to 60x40ft (223 sqm) sites for retrofit on existing buildings.

hyderabad.authority: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB)
hyderabad.notes: Mandatory for plots >= 300 sqm regardless of roof area. Mandatory for all group housing and commercial complexes.

mumbai.notes: Mandatory for buildings on plots >= 300 sqm per state rule. MCGM imposes stricter requirements on plots >= 1000 sqm.

pune.notes: Same state rule as Mumbai — mandatory for plots >= 300 sqm.

delhi.authority: Delhi Jal Board (DJB) / Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA)
delhi.regulation: Ministry of Urban Development notification 2001 + DJB RWH mandate 2012
delhi.notes: Mandatory for plots >= 1000 sqm OR roof area >= 100 sqm. Notified zones (South + Southwest Delhi) have CGWA-specific stricter rules including all institutions and tube-well sites. Non-compliance = water bill penalty 1.5x.

simple._description: Single-window self-certification or fast-track online approval for small low-rise.
simple.typical_authority_path: Local body / municipal corporation online portal
simple.user_burden_summary: Architect-prepared drawings + standard documents; mostly online; minimal personal visits.

medium._description: Full development control review with multiple NOCs.
medium.typical_authority_path: City development authority (CMDA / BBMP / MCGM / DDA / GHMC / PMC)
medium.user_burden_summary: Architect + structural engineer; multiple NOCs; physical inspections; expect revisions.

complex._description: Multi-authority clearance with possible environmental impact assessment.
criteria_examples: plot_area_sqm > 1000 OR floor_count > 7 OR height_m > 18 OR special_zone (CRZ, heritage, airport)
complex.typical_authority_path: City development authority + state agencies + sometimes central agencies
complex.user_burden_summary: Architect + structural engineer + environmental consultant; many physical inspections; multi-month process; budget for consultant fees.
